_metadata.auto_tier_validation: Every typed benchmark was re-run on the auto tier and its output checked, because the runner records a process that exits 0 as "ok" without diffing output. That sweep caught awfy/json returning a WRONG RESULT on the interpreter tier (a real bug, since fixed: T0 published typed-container writes through plain pn parameters to a detached copy, while MIR wrote in place). awfy/cd remains a 180s timeout on the auto tier. All other auto cells produced correct output.
